description: This source file defines the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface, which extends COBBusinessStep parameterized with Loan, and is part of the 'loan' package of the Fineract project. It represents a step in the collection of business logic related to loans for the Cob (Close Of Book) process.

classes.name: LoanCOBBusinessStep
classes.description: An interface extending COBBusinessStep specifically for Loan entities, representing a business step in the COB process for loans.
